learning_outcomes.text: At the end of the course, students will be able to select one or more surface or thermochemical heat treatment processes when designing a part, justifying their choice and indicating the main parameters of the manufacturing range in compliance with environmental regulations.
Knowledge of the different superficial heat treatment, or thermochemical treatment processes (advantages and drawbacks)
Knowledge of the factors influencing the quality of heat treatments
Knowledge of the surface or thermochemical treatment control methods to be used
Knowledge of how to select surface or thermochemical treatments, considering the constraints to be met and the properties to be obtained for mechanical applications.
Know how to apply surface or thermochemical treatments.
Be aware of the environmental impact of surface or thermochemical treatments.

syllabus_topics: Different surface heat treatment processes (flashlight, induction, high-energy beams)
Practical session 1: Selection of materials to be treated
Practical session 1: Preparation of the thermochemical treatment process with environmental regulations.
Practical session 1: Metallographic preparation of initial materials
Practical session 2: Treatment in hidden time
Practical session 2: Presentation of obtained results
assessment_rules: The evaluation formula is (1*DS1 + 0.5*TP1) / 1.5. A report must be submitted on Moodle after the practical sessions.
